requirements.source: S17.11.54 p3 arguments; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF508.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(X) reports same-kind IEEE support
requirements.source: S17.11.54 p5 result value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF508.
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(X) is true exactly for real kind type parameters where division accuracy conforms to ISO/IEC 60559:2020; otherwise it is false.

pending.ieee_support_divide-x-same-kind-support-: Guarded branch plan: for each instantiated real kind rk, probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(1.0_rk), IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE([1.0_rk]), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0_rk), and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,1.0_rk); assert scalar and array probes agree. True branch with RADIX=2 and DIGITS=24 sets IEEE_NEAREST and asserts 1.0_rk/3.0_rk equals real(11184811,rk)*2.0_rk**(-25), plus 1.5_rk/0.5_rk equals 3.0_rk; false branch records skip for division-accuracy effects.
